prompt: A prime-time adult animated sitcom background: flat colours and slightly wobbly black outlines, every colour laid on with thick visible oil brushstrokes. Looking straight down from high above onto a narrow 1930s American street at night that runs from the left edge of the frame to the right: the flat rooftops and gutters of the buildings line the top and bottom edges, iron fire escapes repeat along the soot-black brick walls, and wet cobbles run along the middle. A police car parked on the cobbles throws red and blue up the walls. In a puddle on the cobbles, the only sign of the sky: the reflection of a small, perfectly round, solid red moon. One window glows candle yellow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
